title: ロール紙式大判プロッター
description: 設計事務所や印刷サービス店に配置する脚付き大判プロッター。幅広い給紙筐体、実際に開いた排紙口とローラー、無地の薄い湾曲紙、後ろのロール紙/軸/支持、固定の受け布と棒、車輪付き二脚と補強、操作表示面/ボタン、背面サービス板を造形しています。紙と受け布は一式に含まれる固定形状で別点数ではありません。画面は不透明・無表示、印刷/給紙/布の変形・電気機能はありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.388 × 1.133 × 0.685 m、8,612三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A stand-mounted large-format plotter for design offices and print shops. It has a broad feed housing, actual output opening/roller, thin curved blank paper web, rear roll/spindle/supports, fixed fabric catcher and rods, wheeled twin legs/bracing, blank control display/buttons and rear service panel. Paper and catcher are fixed geometry within one model, not additional assets. The screen is opaque and blank; printing, feeding, fabric deformation and electrical functions are absent. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.388 × 1.133 × 0.685 m; 8,612 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
